subject: Investigate 360-gate LOS/detection us-list composition divergence
description: Follow-up from task #18: after the battle_decisions fixes, two ai.list_us repros remain diverging at their baseline frames because the ALL-SOLDIER us-list composition differs — driven by 360-detection-gate line-of-sight differences (wrong soldiers seen / a missing detectable), not by the PC arm. Repros: parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_036/replay-002 @f33630 and linux3/Profile_003/Continue/replay-009 @f13778 (baseline output/parity-audits/resweep-71cd5e503; re-check against resweep-db67cc978). Suspect area: battle_friend_detected_360 / detection LOS gating vs C++ (RHartificialmalignity camp-soldier scan). Also related to the detection.detectables.length cluster (68 traces in resweep-db67cc978).
resolution: The shared 360-LOS/list-composition label was false. Repro 1 used a stale globally batched map position for EVENT_VIEW while Original Position(enemy) observed the newer owner-boundary world position; the shorter false distance triggered immediate BattleDecisions and rebuilt list_us. Repro 2 incorrectly handled EventTimer in SeekingCombatAlert; Original runs FAST overview only for EventReachPoint. The first replay passes its old boundary; the second fix is source-exact and unit-covered, with its old branch replay masked by the separately fixed reciprocal shield prerequisite.
